invariants: admission is bounded by dependency validity and queue backpressure
dispatch is priority ordered with deterministic aging and tenant fairness
a lease reserves declared resources and only its worker, lease, and fence may act
expiry fences the worker and recovery requires a bounded retry or terminal failure
same operation ID and request digest replay identically; conflicts reject
checkpoint recovery and terminal reconciliation preserve dependency outcomes

fairness.aging: priority plus waited-seconds divided by aging quantum

lease.recovery: expiry releases reservation and retries or fails

limitations: The model evaluates in-memory deterministic observations only.
It does not persist Coordinator state, enforce OS resources, launch workers, or prove live lease validity.
follow_up: Integrate with Coordinator-owned revision, claim, lease, and durable event APIs after independent review.
